notes.title: New Patch - Tino Tini's Soccer 99' Freeplay Mode + Scene Select Menu
notes.notes: [p]Hi! [/p][p]We released a new patch for the game a few days ago. The patch includes a bunch of bug fixes, plus two new features:[/p][p][/p][h3]Tino Tini's Soccer 99' freeplay mode:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43839262/61efd76e94dd2b8c9f2a730c3294c42ac18b4532.png"][/img]You can now play the soccer minigame over and over! Select your favorite country from the South American Qualifiers (Ecuador I hope) and play as long as you want. Each country has a different difficulty level so try to beat them all![/p][p]And, if you connect a second controller, you can play locally against a friend![/p][p][/p][h3]Scene Selection Mode:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43839262/42f46fd50c4189bd555df91cefab725659e98cc0.png"][/img]You can now jump in to any scene in the game directly, so you can easily relive your favorite moments or find interactions you missed. Also, you can now skip the cutscenes if you want to go straight to the gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p]In order to access these two extra modes, you have to finish the game first! However, I must sadly confess that I forgot to track whether players finished the game already in the original release build (sorry!), so if you want to access these modes just [u][b]press start (or escape) 5 times when the logos appear after the game launches[/b][/u][b],[/b] and a new option in the title menu will appear.[/p][p][/p][h3]Full patch notes:[/h3][list][*][p]New feature: Tino Tini's Soccer 99' freeplay mode[/p][/*][*][p]New feature: Scene Selection Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Accessibility feature: option to toggle the sprint button to run.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: weird case where ball outside of stadium in Tino Tini dream was lost[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: ball getting stuck in corner of goal in soccer match dream.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: teacher teleports out of class if you arrive back after he arrives.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: windows look more like windows now hopefully[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: grey box on watch font when playing on lower resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: teens can push you into the dog giving birth hut and there is no escape[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: sister gets locked in at La Liebre while playing hide and seek and you can’t progress the day.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: if u fall in first dream u get the child animation/sound[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: credits broken when playing in chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Y-axis inversion don’t apply to cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: friends can get stuck in the lightbox in the final scene[/p][/*][/list][p]Finally, we wanted to thank everyone who has played the game so far and has been writing such kind words about it in steam reviews and other other internet places. We put our hearts and souls into the game for so long and it is so encouraging to see people connect with it so deeply now. Thanks![/p]
